entries: Sunrise was at 6:57 AM with 11 h 11 m of daylight. Since 6:00 AM at North Island, no rain; air 63–76 °F (17–24 °C) and humidity 73–87%, 76 °F (24 °C) and 74% at 11:52 AM. Water 74 °F (23.6 °C) at CDIP 191, 73–74 °F (22.9–23.6 °C) over the morning.

CDIP 191 at 11:00 AM: 12.5 s from W 270°, 3.4 ft (1.03 m); 13.3 s from S 186°, 3.3 ft (1.00 m). At 5:00 AM: 14.3 s from S 183°, 3.0 ft (0.93 m); 11.1 s from W 271°, 2.9 ft (0.87 m); wind sea 4.2 s from WNW 298°, 1.2 ft (0.36 m). Breaking at 11:00 AM, against 5:00 AM: North 4.1 ft (1.26 m), little change; Center 4.4 ft (1.34 m), filling from 3.6 ft (1.09 m); South 4.2 ft (1.28 m), filling from 3.5 ft (1.05 m). Coming: west swell (250–280°) rose at Tanner Banks (NDBC 46047) from 8:21 AM, 12–14 s first; by deep-water speed it is due at CDIP 191 around 1:47 PM, at the breaks 28–45 min after. Due, not seen.

The tide is dropping to 3.4 ft (1.03 m) at 12:57 PM then pushing to 6.1 ft (1.85 m) at 6:43 PM. The previous AM high was 6.0 ft (1.82 m) at 7:13 AM. The gauge is running 1.4 ft (0.44 m) over the harmonic prediction, over the last 3 days. Today's range is 3.9 ft (1.20 m), building toward springs; springs around Oct 25. On the 2016 survey the tide moves where the waves break, not how big they are; this season's sandbars are not known.

SSW 210° at 13 mph (11 kt) at 11:52 AM: onshore at all three breaks. At this hour on the 33 days before: North onshore on 12, cross-shore on 13; Center onshore on 16; South onshore on 20. Median 9 mph (8 kt).

Former hurricane [Trudy](https://www.nhc.noaa.gov/archive/2026/TRUDY_graphics.php): every fix NHC has logged or forecast is behind land from Point Loma South, so nothing it has sent reaches the breaks.
